title: Presence of Drones near Changi Airport and Delays Caused to Flights
what_it_is: Presence of Drones near Changi Airport and Delays Caused to Flights

sections.label: Changi Airport drone intrusions
sections.summary: The recent drone intrusions were the first confirmed intrusions into Changi Airport, causing 55 flight delays and eight diversions over two nights on 18 and 24 June 2019.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: The recent drone intrusions are the first confirmed intrusions into Changi Airport that we have encountered.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: They disrupted airport operations and led to 55 flight delays and eight diversions over two nights on 18 and 24 June 2019.

sections.label: Drone registration and licensing
sections.summary: A mandatory registration regime for all drones operating in Singapore and a licensing framework for pilots of large or more capable drones will be introduced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: First, we will introduce a mandatory registration regime for all drones operating in Singapore as well as a licensing framework for pilots of large or more capable drones.

sections.label: Drone operators charged
sections.summary: Last week, two persons who operated a drone close to an aerodrome were charged.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Last week, two persons who operated a drone close to an aerodrome were charged.

sections.label: Fines for drone convictions
sections.summary: If convicted, they could face fines of up to $20,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: If convicted, they could face fines of up to $20,000.

sections.label: UAS Advisory Panel timeline
sections.summary: The UAS Advisory Panel was set up in May 2019 to look into issues including mandating UAS registration, with hope to do so by the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: On the first query on the timeline for the mandatory registration, we have set up the UAS Advisory Panel in May 2019, who will be looking into some of these issues, including the suggestion to mandate the registration of UAS and we hope to be able to do so by the end of this year.

sections.label: Geofencing disabled and counter-drone capability
sections.summary: The assessment is that geofencing was disabled so it could not prevent these intrusions, and CAAS and CAG will enhance their own capability to detect and counter drones.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Unfortunately, in this particular case, we are of the assessment that such a capability has been disabled so that the geofencing solutions will not be capable of preventing these intrusions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: As to the Member's second question of the capabilities of CAAS and CAG, MOT and CAAS are working with the various agencies to continue to tap on the security agencies' assets whenever possible or whenever necessary, without compromising their own operational needs.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: But in the medium term, CAAS and CAG will also be enhancing their own capability to detect and counter drones on an expedited basis.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: So, the answer in short is that CAG, together with CAAS, will have their own internal capabilities as soon as possible.

sections.label: Drone intrusion penalties and detection
sections.summary: Offenders face fines up to $20,000 or 12 months' jail, with priority on detection capabilities and enhanced systems to immobilise drones.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Anyone caught flouting this law will face a fine of up to $20,000 or a jail term of up to 12 months or both.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: We are currently looking at increasing the penalty framework for such offences.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: Well, I would say that our priority right now is to beef up our existing capabilities to detect these drone intrusions as quickly as possible, very promptly, and to ensure that our air traffic operations continue to function safely with minimal disruptions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lam Pin Min
sentences.text: At the same time, we will also put in place enhanced detection and disruption systems to be able to immobilise or prevent these drones from causing mayhem in the airspace as well as posing a danger to flights.
